Title: Tool Posture
Text: Reasoning-first case organization. No deterministic helper is required to author case files.

Title: Preferred Validation
Text: After case creation or update, run:  ```sh python3 tools/validation/validate_scc_resolution_case.py <case-folder> ```  Do not claim validator PASS unless it actually ran and passed.

Title: Disallowed Tool Effects
Text: - No writes outside `CASE_PATH` and scoped `_run_records/`. - No mutation of product deliverables. - No mutation of `Dependencies.csv`. - No mutation of `_ScopeChange/`, `_Reconciliation/`, or decomposition authority.
